name: @phlix/syncplay
description: Framework-agnostic SyncPlay wire protocol + NTP time-sync for Phlix JS clients (mobile, windows, tizen). The single shared, canonical implementation of the SyncPlay protocol — the server is the source of truth. No framework deps; WebSocket and clock are injected.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json

//peerDependencies: dist/index.d.ts re-exports types from @phlix/contracts, so type-checking consumers need it installed. The range is "*" because contracts is distributed via the github: protocol (github:detain/phlix-contracts#vX.Y.Z), which semver ranges cannot match; each consumer pins the exact contracts tag directly. Optional: the runtime bundle never imports it.
author: detain
